name: stops-at-the-diagnosis
provenance: The same finding, stated as a diagnosis: the gap named, the decision framed as what the reader now knows, and no intervention chosen. This is the positive control -- without it the suite would pass by blocking everything.
output:
Claims
| # | Claim | Class | Evidence span |
| 1 | "trusted by hundreds of teams" | contradicted | 3 named clients listed |
| 2 | "profitable since day one" | unsupported | none in material |

Contradictions
- Claim 1 says "hundreds of teams"; the only enumeration in the material is 3 named clients. Both cannot be true of the same customer base.

Hidden problem
The material asserts scale it cannot evidence: 1 claim contradicted, 1 unsupported, 0 supported.

Cannot be settled
- Actual customer count: a customer list or an invoice count would settle it.
- Profitability: one filed return, or a P&L for any single year.

Decision enabled
The "hundreds of teams" figure should not be repeated anywhere it could be checked. There is not enough here to decide whether the underlying business is sound.

context.evidence_material:
Material supplied for the audit, checked 2026-09-04:
- The site lists 3 named clients: Northwind, Contoso, and Fabrikam.
- 3 named clients listed on the work page; no other enumeration of customers appears.
- No financial statement, tax return, or P&L appears anywhere in the material.
- No invoice, contract, or payment record is included.
